title: Samsung activates strongest lineup to clinch Korean Series title
text:
Samsung activates strongest lineup to clinch Korean Series title - CHOSUNBIZ 
 2026년 11월 8일(일) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Sports Samsung activates strongest lineup to clinch Korean Series title 
 입력 2026.11.08. 11:40 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 One win away from a Korean Series title for the first time in 12 years. Professional baseball's Samsung Lions have rolled out their strongest lineup to secure the championship.
 Samsung revealed the starting lineup for game 5 of the Korean Series against the KT Wiz at Daegu Samsung Lions Park on the 8th. Leading the series 3-1, Samsung can clinch the title in front of their home fans with a win that day.
 The most notable is foreign hitter Lewin Díaz returning to the cleanup spot. Strengthening the heart of the order, veteran catcher Kang Min-ho will also don the starting mask again.
 Samsung set the starting batting order as Kim Ji-chan (center field) - Park Seung-gyu (right field) - Gu Ja-wook (designated hitter) - Lewin Díaz (first base) - Choi Hyoung-woo (left field) - Kim Young-woong (third base) - Lee Jay-hyun (shortstop) - Ryu Ji-hyuk (second base) - Kang Min-ho (catcher).
 On the mound to start is 'the ace of blue blood' Won Tae-in. The ace has taken on the important starting responsibility in a crucial game that can secure the team's championship.
 Samsung, on the verge of reclaiming the title for the first time in 12 years. With their strongest roster, they are determined to finish the Korean Series at home.
